leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a functional component in TypeScript to serve as the root of a component hierarchy.
Implement a TypeScript interface to specify the shape of props passed to a component.
Assign props to a child component by passing them as attributes in JSX.
Access props within a child component to render dynamic content.
Construct a component tree by nesting multiple components that pass data down.
Utilize the spread operator to pass all props from a parent to a child component.
Apply destructuring assignment to extract specific props within a component's parameter list.
Handle optional props by defining them with a union type or optional modifier in the interface.
Modify a prop's value at an intermediate component before passing it further down the tree.
Return JSX elements that correctly display data received through props at each level.
Compare the prop values at different levels of the component tree to verify data flow.
Control the data flow by ensuring props are passed correctly through each intermediate component.
